/* GENERATED by tools/wow64gen/wow64gen.py — DO NOT EDIT BY HAND.
 * Re-run: python3 tools/wow64gen/wow64gen.py --spec fixtures/spec path --arch amd64 \
 *             --sysfuncs ntoskrnl/include/sysfuncs.h --out-c -
 *
 * Table index == REAL service number (sysfuncs.h order — what guest EAX
 * carries); the .spec contributes argument types only.
 *
 * WoW64 32->64 syscall thunk table for arch=amd64. Each thunk reads the
 * guest's 32-bit argument dwords (Arguments[]) and calls the real 64-bit Nt*.
 * A 32-bit guest pointer is a valid 64-bit pointer (guest VA < 4GB), so
 * pointer args are zero-extended. Deep-marshalling cases are emitted as loud
 * WOW64_NEEDS_MANUAL stubs — implement them by hand in wow64.c and remove the
 * generated stub from the table. Count: 1 auto, 5 manual.
 */

#ifndef WOW64_THUNKS_GEN_H_INCLUDED
/* wow64.c provides: PVOID resolve_ntdll_export(const char *name);
 *                   ULONG DbgPrint(const char *fmt, ...);
 * and the WOW64 basic types (ULONG, PVOID, ULONG_PTR, NTSTATUS, ...). */
#endif

typedef NTSTATUS (*WOW64_THUNK)(ULONG *a);

typedef struct _WOW64_THUNK_ENTRY {
    const char *Name;    /* Nt* export name (resolved lazily from ntdll)      */
    WOW64_THUNK Thunk;   /* marshaller, or 0 for a not-yet-implemented manual */
    unsigned char Slots; /* guest arg dwords consumed (sanity/debug)          */
} WOW64_THUNK_ENTRY;

static inline double wow64_bits_to_double(ULONG lo, ULONG hi)
{
    union { ULONGLONG u; double d; } v;
    v.u = ((ULONGLONG)lo) | (((ULONGLONG)hi) << 32);
    return v.d;
}


/* NtFoo: WOW64_NEEDS_MANUAL — listed in --manual-list (struct layout). Implement by hand; table entry left 0. */

/* NtManual: WOW64_NEEDS_MANUAL — arg 'int128' needs deep marshalling. Implement by hand; table entry left 0. */

/* NtUnknown: WOW64_NEEDS_MANUAL — unknown arg token 'banana'. Implement by hand; table entry left 0. */

/* NtMissing: WOW64_NEEDS_MANUAL — in sysfuncs.h but not in .spec (no type info). Implement by hand; table entry left 0. */

extern NTSTATUS NtArch(PVOID, PVOID);
static NTSTATUS wow64_thunk_NtArch(ULONG *a)
{
    (void)a;
    return NtArch((PVOID)(LONG_PTR)(LONG)a[0], (PVOID)(LONG_PTR)(LONG)a[1]);
}

/* NtNegative: WOW64_NEEDS_MANUAL — spec arg dwords 1 != sysfuncs.h argcount 3. Implement by hand; table entry left 0. */

static const WOW64_THUNK_ENTRY TestPrefixTable[] = {
    { "NtFoo", 0, 7 }, /* [0] MANUAL: listed in --manual-list (struct layout) */
    { "NtManual", 0, 4 }, /* [1] MANUAL: arg 'int128' needs deep marshalling */
    { "NtUnknown", 0, 0 }, /* [2] MANUAL: unknown arg token 'banana' */
    { "NtMissing", 0, 9 }, /* [3] MANUAL: in sysfuncs.h but not in .spec (no type info) */
    { "NtArch", wow64_thunk_NtArch, 2 }, /* [4] */
